messages:
Maya P: Customer says they get 401 on hosted API and can't find any trace id in the UI. They have web + iOS but can reproduce on web only. What minimal items should we ask for to triage quickly?
Alex T: Start by asking SDK/platform + exact SDK version (or "web direct"). Also ask whether they see any response headers like `x-request-id` or `x-redwood-trace-id`.
Maya P: OK. I put together a short checklist to send to the customer so we can move fast. Sharing here for review.
Maya P: --- Minimal triage checklist for 401 / missing trace ids ---
Maya P: 1) Platform & version: web / iOS / Android and SDK version (or "web direct").
Maya P: 2) Timestamp: local time when the 401 occurred (include timezone).
Maya P: 3) Region: which API region they hit, if known (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1).
Maya P: 4) DevTools HAR + header screenshot: For web please open Browser DevTools -> Network -> reproduce the failing request (filter `POST /v1/generate` or `POST /v1/chat`).
Maya P:    - Click the failing request -> Headers -> copy Request headers (as text) and take a screenshot of Response headers.
Maya P:    - Look for response headers named exactly `x-request-id` or `x-redwood-trace-id` or `x-redwood-session`.
Maya P:    - If there are no visible trace headers, ask them to right-click -> Save all as HAR with content and attach the HAR.
Maya P: Example headers to highlight (paste exact names):
Maya P: ```
Maya P: Request headers:
Maya P:   Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Maya P:   Content-Type: application/json
Maya P: Response headers:
Maya P:   x-request-id: 7a3f2d1e
Maya P:   x-redwood-trace-id: 2026-03-17T12:34:56Z-9b2c
Maya P: ```
Maya P: 5) Minimal reproducible curl (run with `-i`): ask them to replace the body with the smallest failing payload and redact keys. Provide this template: 
Maya P: ```
Maya P: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
Maya P:   -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>"
Maya P:   -H "Content-Type: application/json"
Maya P:   -d '{"model":"some-model","input":"test"}'
Maya P: ```
Maya P: Tell them to paste the full `curl -i` output (status line + headers + body).
Maya P: 6) SDK debug token (if using our SDKs): give these quick snippets so they can produce a debug token to attach.
Maya P:    - JS/RN: `const t = await RedwoodClient.createDebugToken(); console.log(t.debug_token)`
Maya P:    - Swift (iOS): `let token = try await RedwoodClient.shared.createDebugToken()`
Maya P:    - If they can't run code, request a screenshot of the SDK logs around the failing request (search logs for "redwood" or "trace").
Maya P: 7) If they can't reproduce locally: short screen recording (30s) of DevTools Network reproducing the request, or a Loom link.
Maya P: 8) Small metadata file to attach with uploads:
Maya P:    - customer_local_timestamp: 2026-03-17T12:34:56+00:00
Maya P:    - region: us-east-1
Maya P:    - platform: web / iOS / Android
Maya P:    - sdk_version: <version or "web direct">
Maya P: --- End checklist ---
Alex T: Security / PII reminder (short): ask them to replace API keys with `<REDACTED>` and mask any user PII in HAR files before upload. If HAR contains big sensitive bodies, they can open it in an editor and remove the sensitive fields or upload to a secure file share.
Sam (support): Also note: when we get a trace id we run an internal correlation: `search-traces x-request-id=7a3f2d1e` or `search-traces x-redwood-trace-id=2026-...` and expand the window +/- 5 minutes from the customer timestamp. If no hits, we ask for HAR + exact client timestamp and region and let eng-oncall widen the search to proxies and edge logs.
Sam (support): If they attach logs/HAR/curl, ask them to include: customer timestamp, endpoint path, and whether the request was proxied (CDN/proxy name).
Maya P: I'll add the exact curl template and the debugger commands to the customer reply.
support-bot: created ticket #INC-2026-541 and attached the checklist.
support-bot: assigned to Sam (support) and pinged eng-oncall.
eng-oncall: noted. If we don't find the trace id in service logs, include the HAR + customer timestamp. I'll check frontend proxies, LB logs, and the edge for missing headers.
Maya P: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" — sending this to the customer now with the HAR + curl request examples.
